scenes.title: A boat from Sela Thorn
scenes.summary: The party looks for a boat to the old chapel. Sela Thorn, a tide-reader, agrees to row them for two silver but never at night, and will wait at pier four at first light. She says Saltmere flooded the night the bell first rang forty years ago, with warm water.

scenes.title: Hymn pages in the Saltmere Mine
scenes.place: Saltmere Mine, cliff path above Gullwick
scenes.summary: The mine floods thirty paces in with warm black water and floating hymn-book pages. One page has the pencilled margin note "M. Brand", which Teo recognises as his sister Mira's handwriting. Dana and Priya guess the harbor-master Maren is in the cult; Oren takes 2 damage from bad air.

scenes.title: The bell rings at midnight
scenes.place: Shore below the drowned chapel, Gullwick bay
scenes.summary: At dusk fishermen warn of the Kelp Mother and leave. At midnight the bell rings twelve times under the water, the humming is louder than two nights ago, and pale shapes stand in rows on the chapel floor. The party flees. The GM notes the choir clock is at three of six.

scenes.title: Plan for the dive at the Tarred Gull
scenes.place: The Tarred Gull, tavern by the docks
scenes.summary: The party decides to dive to the chapel at low tide in daylight, with Sela rowing them at first light. Innkeeper Bram gives them free stew and says Maren is a good-hearted friend who lost a brother to the bay. The party takes a long rest and the session ends.
